milestone.describes: The main menu is the rated milestone. The rest of this route is the frontier: it reaches the song list and starts loading a song, which is where the app currently stops.

steps.expect: Main menu: the logo, the tutorial banner, the avatar panel, the "You are offline" notice, the Online / 1 Player / 2 Player wheel and the red Play button. This is the two-star milestone.
The Career song list: Back and Home in the bar, Easy / Medium / Hard / Extreme tabs, and three songs with their artwork - Get Crazy, Tap Tap Domination, Louder Than Boom.
The loading screen for the first song: its artwork and title under a "Loading" banner, with a gameplay tip along the bottom.
Still the loading screen. It does not finish - see dev-docs/app-notes/tap-tap-revenge-3.md for what is known about the stall.

notes: The song list was empty until UITableView learned to load its rows on first layout. If a replay finds it empty again, that is the regression to look for first.
The rows are at roughly (160, 120), (160, 200) and (160, 280); they are ordinary table rows 80 points apart.
Text tapHLE draws for this app comes out rotated 180 degrees, so the song titles and the tip read backwards. That is a rendering bug, not a sign the replay went wrong.
The difficulty tabs across the top are live - a tap on one reaches a UIButton - but the list does not visibly change, so there is no way to tell from a capture which is selected.
